description: issue #681 (slice I2): `spec/interaction-events.md:131` — "`ol-type` if the prompt cannot be displayed as learner text". A list is a structured value whose printed form is a container view, not a question authored for a learner, so it is not learner text; the accepted prompts are the scalars `word`, `number`, and `boolean`, whose printed form IS the characters displayed. The span points at the offending prompt argument, not the whole call. The diagnostic carries the `{ operation, expected, actual }` identity shape the profile`s other `ol-type` builders use (`when`/`on_key`), with `expected: "text"` naming the spec`s own phrase. The prompt is validated BEFORE the read, so the answer queue is untouched and no `primitive` event is emitted — a rejected prompt must not silently consume the next answer and leave every later read off by one.

diagnostics.message: input needs a prompt it can show as text, but got a list.
